description: Get a published saved form's action URL, one-line JavaScript embed, minimal native form action, and fetch example, for Astro, Hugo, Jekyll, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages, or other non-Webflow sites. Install embed.javascript (embed.recommendedSnippet) wherever the page can run a script tag: it is the only snippet with Sequenzy's spam protection. The form appears right after the script tag; when the script must load elsewhere (page head, tag manager, site-wide layout), put embed.placeholder where the form should appear and the script fills it. Use nativeForm or fetch only on a page that cannot run scripts, and tell the user embed.reducedProtectionWarning when you do. For a Webflow-connected company, returns embed.disabled plus the native Webflow settings path and no custom code.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

formId.description: Saved form ID returned by list_forms or create_form.

name: get_form_embed

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_form_embed` MCP tool.

embed.description: Public action URL plus JavaScript, native form, and fetch snippets, with recommendedSnippet (javascript, the only one with spam protection), placeholder (positions the javascript form when its script loads elsewhere) and reducedProtectionWarning to show when nativeForm or fetch is used.

form.description: The saved form record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.
